title: Fitness metric
description: A dated physiological or performance benchmark.

type.description: The metric type, such as FTP, CRITICAL_POWER, VO2_MAX, or MAX_HEART_RATE.

unit.description: The canonical unit symbol for the primary value.

secondaryValue.description: The optional paired value, such as W-prime for critical power or D-prime for critical speed.

secondaryUnit.description: The canonical unit symbol for the optional secondary value.

provider.description: The external provider that supplied the value, when available.

sportType.description: The sport type to which the metric applies.

effectiveDate.description: The date and time from which this value is effective in ISO 8601 format.

metricSource.description: How the value was obtained, such as AUTO, ESTIMATED, MANUAL, or SNAPSHOT.

source.description: The system or user action that originally supplied this record.

sourceExternalId.description: The stable record identifier assigned by the source system, when available.

sourceUpdatedAt.description: The last modification time reported by the source system in ISO 8601 format.
